title: Step 4b - Creating a Scatter Plot with Regression Line in R Using ggplot2

cues.en: Instructor: And now let's add the following component which is our regression line.
cues.zh: 接著加入下一個元件，也就是迴歸線。

cues.en: So, here we add a little plus and then enter.
cues.zh: 這裡加一個 +，再換行。

cues.en: So, to plot the observation points, we used geom point and now very intuitively to plot the regression line, we're gonna use geom line.
cues.zh: 觀測點使用 geom_point，畫迴歸線則直覺地使用 geom_line。

cues.en: Alright? So, pretty easy to remember.
cues.zh: 很好記。

cues.en: And then in this line, same as for the points we're gonna take the x-coordinate and the y-coordinate of our regression line.
cues.zh: 和觀測點一樣，這裡也要指定迴歸線的 x 與 y 座標。

cues.en: So, let's see.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: First, we need to take the function aesthetic, a-e-s parenthesis, and that's where we put the x and the y.
cues.zh: 先呼叫 aes()，在裡面設定 x 與 y。

cues.en: So, in your opinion, what is going to be the x?
cues.zh: 你認為 x 會是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the x is going to be the years experience of the training set because we want to have the predictions of the salaries for the observations in the training set.
cues.zh: x 是訓練集的工作年資，因為要取得訓練集觀測值的預測薪資。

cues.en: So, in the x-axis, we need to have the number of years of experience of the training set observations.
cues.zh: 所以 x 軸需要訓練集觀測值的年資。

cues.en: So here, I'm just going to copy this
cues.zh: 我直接複製這裡，

cues.en: there and place it here.
cues.zh: 貼到這裡。

cues.en: But now, what is going to be the y?
cues.zh: y 又是什麼？

cues.en: It's not going to be training set salary, obviously because we don't want to take the real salaries now.
cues.zh: 很明顯，不是 training_set$Salary，因為現在不要實際薪資。

cues.en: We want to take the predicted salaries.
cues.zh: 而是預測薪資。

cues.en: So, in order to take the predicted salaries we will very simply use again this predict function.
cues.zh: 要取得預測薪資，只需再用 predict。

cues.en: We cannot use again, y pred here because y pred is the predicted salaries of the test set observations.
cues.zh: 不能直接使用 y_pred，因為它是測試集觀測值的預測薪資。

cues.en: But here we want to get the training set predicted salaries.
cues.zh: 這裡需要的是訓練集預測薪資。

cues.en: So, we will copy this predict to take the predictions of the training set salaries,
cues.zh: 所以複製 predict，取得訓練集薪資的預測。

cues.en: and, therefore, in new data here we need to replace test set by training set.
cues.zh: 再把 newdata 的 test_set 換成 training_set。

cues.en: And now it's good.
cues.zh: 現在就對了。

cues.en: Now, this geom line function here will plot all the predicted salaries of the training set observations.
cues.zh: geom_line 會畫出所有訓練集觀測值的預測薪資。

cues.en: And so, for each employee with the same number of years of experience, because here we have the same x we're gonna have both the real salaries,
cues.zh: 所以對相同年資的每位員工，因為 x 相同，我們同時有實際薪資，

cues.en: the salaries they actually have in the company, and the salaries predicted by our simple in Linear Regression model for the same employees.
cues.zh: 也就是公司真正付給他的薪資，以及簡單線性迴歸預測出的薪資。

cues.en: Okay, so it's ready.
cues.zh: 準備完成。

cues.en: The line is ready, but as for the observation points, we will just add a color.
cues.zh: 線已設定好，但和觀測點一樣，再加顏色。

cues.en: And then that means that we need to put a comma here and press enter.
cues.zh: 這裡加逗號，再換行。

cues.en: And that's where we put the second argument which is going to be the color.
cues.zh: 填入第二個引數，也就是 color。

cues.en: And this time we will pick a blue color.
cues.zh: 這次選 blue。

cues.en: So again, that's just my taste.
cues.zh: 同樣只是我的偏好。

cues.en: You're welcome to use some other colors if you prefer.
cues.zh: 你也可以使用其他喜歡的顏色。

cues.en: Okay, so now our plot is almost ready.
cues.zh: 現在圖表快完成了。

cues.en: We have all the observation points of the training set.
cues.zh: 有訓練集全部觀測點。

cues.en: We have the regression line.
cues.zh: 也有迴歸線。

cues.en: And so now we could plot the graph now, but if we want to have a nice graph that we want to present to people like managers or clients, or even your friends, it's always better to add a little title
cues.zh: 現在就能畫出來，但如果要呈現給主管、客戶，或朋友看，最好加個標題，

cues.en: and some labels on the axis.
cues.zh: 再加上座標軸標籤。

cues.en: So, let's do this plus here and gg.
cues.zh: 所以這裡加 +，再寫 gg。

cues.en: So, this time it's not geom, it's gg because it's not a geometrical thing.
cues.zh: 這次不是 geom，因為不是幾何圖形元件。

cues.en: GG title, parenthesis, quotes because we have to put the title of our plot in quotes.
cues.zh: 使用 ggtitle，括號中用引號填標題。

cues.en: And here we're gonna give the following title, "Salary vs.
cues.zh: 標題設為 Salary vs.

cues.en: Experience."
cues.zh: Experience。

cues.en: And we are going to specify that it's the training set
cues.zh: 再標明 Training set，

cues.en: because then we will do the same for the test set.
cues.zh: 因為之後還會畫測試集。

cues.en: And close the parenthesis.
cues.zh: 補上括號。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: So perfect, that's our title.
cues.zh: 很好，標題就有了。

cues.en: And now, let's just add a name of the x-axis.
cues.zh: 再替 x 軸加名稱。

cues.en: So, to do this, we use the xlab and in parentheses we will say that the name of our x-axis is going to be "Years of experience."
cues.zh: 使用 xlab()，把 x 軸名稱設為 Years of Experience。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And then plus, and then same for our y-axis and obviously it's going to be ylab.
cues.zh: 再加 +，替 y 軸做同樣的事，當然使用 ylab。

cues.en: And here we'll choose salary, very simply.
cues.zh: 這裡簡單設為 Salary。

cues.en: Okay, and our graph is ready to be plotted.
cues.zh: 現在圖表已準備好。

cues.en: So, I'm going to select all this and now press command and control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取整段，按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here is our beautiful graph.
cues.zh: 這就是漂亮的圖表。

cues.en: So, that's the training set results with the real training set observations, with the real salaries in red and the regression line in blue.
cues.zh: 訓練集結果中，實際薪資觀測值是紅點，迴歸線是藍色。

cues.en: So, let's zoom this graph and let's give an interpretation.
cues.zh: 放大，來解讀一下。

cues.en: Alright, so this is our training set results.
cues.zh: 這是訓練集結果。

cues.en: So, we can clearly make the distinction between the real observations, which are the red points.
cues.zh: 可以清楚分辨，真實觀測值就是紅點。

cues.en: So, these are the real salaries of the employees in the company.
cues.zh: 也就是員工在公司的實際薪資。

cues.en: And this blue straight line here is our Linear Regression model.
cues.zh: 這條藍色直線，就是線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: So, that's the prediction that means that, for example, if we take this employee here, well, we can see that his number of years of experience is a little more than five years of experience.
cues.zh: 也就是預測。例如這位員工的年資，大約比五年多一點。

cues.en: His real salary is about $65,000.
cues.zh: 實際薪資約為 65,000 美元。

cues.en: But, our model predicted for this particular employee, this result here.
cues.zh: 但模型對這位員工的預測，是這裡的結果。

cues.en: That means he predicted that this employee has a salary of a little less than $75,000.
cues.zh: 也就是略低於 75,000 美元。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the real important distinction to understand.
cues.zh: 這是非常重要、必須理解的差別。

cues.en: This is the real value, and this is the predicted value of the model.
cues.zh: 這是實際值，這是模型預測值。

cues.en: And to get the predicted salary you need to project this point of the line here onto the salary axis which give us a predicted salary
cues.zh: 要取得預測薪資，就把直線上的這個點，投影到薪資軸，得到

cues.en: of a little less than $75,000.
cues.zh: 略低於 75,000 美元的預測。
